documentation.content: One prod API, sync or listen backend has more than 1000 HTTP 429/min (5-minute aligned rate) for 30 minutes. Inspect backend_target_name, Cloud Armor denied_by_security_policy vs backend 429s, path/method cohorts, app-build adoption and Retry-After. Compare job polls, duplicate upload share, pending age and completion together; use the measure.sh approach in the runbook. The LB metric counts all 429s, not only Cloud Armor denials. Follow https://github.com/BasedHardware/omi/blob/main/backend/docs/runbooks/request-storm-alerts.md.

conditions.displayName: One backend exceeds 1000 HTTP 429/min for 30 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: metric.type="loadbalancing.googleapis.com/https/request_count" AND resource.type="https_lb_rule" AND resource.labels.project_id="based-hardware" AND (resource.labels.backend_target_name="custom-domains-api-omi-me-backend-49a4-be" OR resource.labels.backend_target_name="custom-domains-api-omi-me-backend-sync-49a4-be" OR resource.labels.backend_target_name="custom-domains-api-omi-me-backend-listen-49a4-be") AND metric.labels.response_code="429"
